description: Real production XAU closed-bar capture (M5/M15/H1) taken after the 2-6 Oct Session Level losses, covering the 6 Oct 05:00 PDL trade and the following week. Used by the Session Level v4 certification as the out-of-sample XAU window. Nothing here is synthetic or edited.

provenance.source: Redis bars:XAU:{TF} populated by the live cTrader feed, read-only from the production host (zrange, oldest first)
provenance.capture_note: M5 retention on the production host is 2000 bars; M15 and H1 are trimmed to the newest 600 and 500 bars
